basic_details.short_information: The Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers Limited (TNPL) has officially announced the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening under Advertisement No. DIPR/656/DISPLAY/2026. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.tnpl.com/. Candidates aged up to 65 years who hold a Graduation in Science with specialization in Chemistry or Organic Chemistry can submit their offline applications up to 12 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and offline application form are shared below.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for TNPL Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.tnpl.com.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TNPL Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the TNPL Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) position is 12th August 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) position, candidates must possess a Graduation in Science with a specialization in Chemistry or Organic Chemistry. This is the primary academic requirement for the role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) post is 65 years. There is no minimum age specified, but candidates must not exceed the stated maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates are exempt from paying any application fee for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) post in the Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers (TNPL) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application mode for the TNPL Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant (Tissue Quality Assurance) position is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of TNPL, which is www.tnpl.com. It is recommended to visit the website and navigate to the careers or recruitment section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DIPR/656/DISPLAY/2026. This number should be clearly mentioned on the application form if required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with a pincode of 600032. Candidates applying should be willing to work in this location.
